className.en-US: Class name of the root element.

style.en-US: Inline style of the root element.

disabled.zh-CN: 是否禁用整个穿梭框，包括搜索框、选项和操作按钮。
disabled.en-US: Whether the whole transfer is disabled, including the search box, the options and the action buttons.

dataSource.zh-CN: 数据源。`list` 类型为数据项数组，`groupList` 为分组数组，`treeList` 为带 `children` 的树形数据。
dataSource.en-US: Data source: an array of items for `list`, an array of groups for `groupList`, or tree data with `children` for `treeList`.

filter.zh-CN: 搜索的筛选逻辑。为 `false` 时不显示搜索框；传入函数时用它替代默认匹配，返回 `true` 表示保留该项；默认按 `label` 不区分大小写匹配。`treeList` 想自定义搜索时需设为 `true`，并通过 `treeProps` 的 `filterTreeNode` 传入匹配函数。
filter.en-US: Filtering of the search. `false` hides the search box; a function replaces the default case-insensitive match on `label` and returns `true` to keep an item. For a custom search in `treeList`, set it to `true` and pass the matching function as `filterTreeNode` in `treeProps`.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 默认已选中的 value 数组，只在创建时读取。
defaultValue.en-US: Values selected initially, read once when the transfer is created.

value.zh-CN: 已选中的 value 数组，传入后即为受控组件，数组顺序就是右侧的显示顺序；传入 `undefined` 回到非受控。
value.en-US: Values of the selected items. Passing it makes the component controlled, and its order is the order on the right; `undefined` returns to uncontrolled.

inputProps.zh-CN: 传给搜索框 Input 的属性，可配置项参考 Input；`value` 与 `onChange` 由 Transfer 占用，需要外部驱动搜索时调用 ref 上的 `search` 方法。
inputProps.en-US: Props passed to the search Input, see Input for the options. `value` and `onChange` belong to Transfer; to search from outside, call the `search` method on the ref.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 自定义空状态的提示：`left` 为左侧没有数据时，`right` 为右侧没有已选项时，`search` 为搜索没有结果时。某一项为 `null` 时不渲染对应的空状态；未提供时显示语言包文案。
emptyContent.en-US: Custom empty-state content: `left` when the left list has no data, `right` when nothing is selected, `search` when the search matches nothing. A `null` entry hides that empty state; a missing one shows the locale text.

draggable.zh-CN: 是否开启右侧已选项的拖拽排序。排序后 `onChange` 的数组顺序随之改变。
draggable.en-US: Enables drag sorting of the selected items on the right. After a sort, the order of the array passed to `onChange` changes.

treeProps.zh-CN: 仅 `treeList` 有效，传给左侧 Tree 的属性，会覆盖默认的 `multiple`、`disableStrictly`、`leafOnly`、`filterTreeNode`、`defaultExpandAll` 与 `searchRender`（为 `false`）。`value`、`treeData`、`keyMaps`、`treeDataSimpleJson`、`onChangeWithObject`、`onChange` 与 `ref` 由 Transfer 决定，传入会被忽略。
treeProps.en-US: `treeList` only: props passed to the Tree on the left, overriding the defaults `multiple`, `disableStrictly`, `leafOnly`, `filterTreeNode`, `defaultExpandAll` and `searchRender` (`false`). `value`, `treeData`, `keyMaps`, `treeDataSimpleJson`, `onChangeWithObject`, `onChange` and `ref` belong to Transfer and are ignored.

showPath.zh-CN: 仅 `treeList` 有效，控制右侧已选项是否显示从根节点到自身的选择路径。
showPath.en-US: `treeList` only: whether the selected items on the right show their path from the root.

loading.zh-CN: 左侧选项是否正在加载，加载中用 Spin 代替列表。
loading.en-US: Whether the options on the left are loading; a Spin replaces the list while they load.

virtualize.zh-CN: 右侧已选列表虚拟化，仅在默认右侧面板且 `draggable` 为 `false` 时生效。`height` 为数字时按像素生效，为其他值时按面板剩余高度测量；`itemSize` 为每行高度。
virtualize.en-US: Virtualizes the selected list on the right, only with the default right panel and `draggable` off. A numeric `height` applies in pixels; any other value is measured from the remaining panel height. `itemSize` is the height of each row.

pagination.zh-CN: 左侧面板的分页配置，仅对 `list` 与 `groupList` 生效。`onPageChange` 写在该对象内。
pagination.en-US: Paging of the left panel, for `list` and `groupList` only. `onPageChange` lives inside the object.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中值变化时触发，拖拽排序后也会触发。参数依次为 value 数组与对应的数据项数组。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, including after a drag sort, with the array of values and the array of their items.

onSelect.zh-CN: 勾选一项时触发，参数为该数据项。
onSelect.en-US: Called when an item is checked, with that item.

onDeselect.zh-CN: 取消勾选一项时触发，参数为该数据项。
onDeselect.en-US: Called when an item is unchecked, with that item.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索框输入内容变化时触发，参数为搜索值。通过 ref 的 `search` 方法驱动的搜索不触发。
onSearch.en-US: Called when the text of the search box changes, with the search value. A search driven by the ref's `search` method does not call it.

renderSourceItem.zh-CN: 自定义左侧单个候选项的渲染，每次渲染时为每个选项调用一次。参数为数据项，另含 `checked` 与 `onChange`，`onChange` 切换该项的勾选状态。
renderSourceItem.en-US: Renders one candidate on the left, called once per item on every render. The argument is the item plus `checked` and `onChange`, which toggles the checked state of the item.

renderSelectedItem.zh-CN: 自定义右侧单个已选项的渲染，每次渲染时为每个选项调用一次。参数为数据项，另含 `onRemove`；`draggable` 时还有 `sortableHandle`。`treeList` 且 `showPath` 时可通过 `fullPath` 获取完整路径。
renderSelectedItem.en-US: Renders one selected item on the right, called once per item on every render. The argument is the item plus `onRemove`; with `draggable` it also has `sortableHandle`. With `treeList` and `showPath`, `fullPath` holds the whole path.

renderSourcePanel.zh-CN: 完全自定义左侧候选面板，每次渲染时调用，参数为 SourcePanelProps。
renderSourcePanel.en-US: Replaces the whole left panel; called on every render with SourcePanelProps.

renderSelectedPanel.zh-CN: 完全自定义右侧已选面板，每次渲染时调用，参数为 SelectedPanelProps。
renderSelectedPanel.en-US: Replaces the whole right panel; called on every render with SelectedPanelProps.

renderSourceHeader.zh-CN: 自定义左侧面板头部，每次渲染时调用，参数为 SourceHeaderProps。`leafOnlyNum` 仅 `treeList` 提供。
renderSourceHeader.en-US: Replaces the header of the left panel; called on every render with SourceHeaderProps. `leafOnlyNum` is provided for `treeList` only.

renderSelectedHeader.zh-CN: 自定义右侧面板头部，每次渲染时调用，参数为 SelectedHeaderProps。
renderSelectedHeader.en-US: Replaces the header of the right panel; called on every render with SelectedHeaderProps.

ref.zh-CN: 接收 `TransferHandle` 句柄，只暴露 `search` 方法，不是根元素。
ref.en-US: Receives a `TransferHandle` that exposes only the `search` method; it is not the root element.

search.zh-CN: 按输入了该值来搜索，该值会被置给搜索框；不触发 `onSearch`。
search.en-US: Searches as if the value were typed into the search box, and puts the value there; `onSearch` is not called.
